text:
anya: quick callout we saw ~60 silent streaming sessions in eu this morning: TCP stayed open but no SSE/WS frames for 20-70s, then resumed. no FIN/RST in tcp.

sam: link to sample trace?

anya: trace c0ffee -> https://console/redwood/trace/c0ffee. ops-bot alert at 2026-03-21T07:12Z: streaming.silent-output spike.

ryan: proxy log shows `quiesce_enter` correlated with `tls_rekey` events. proxy set quiesce to avoid thundering reconnects.

tina: product: interactive apps hate the spinner gap; want deterministic UX when resume happens.

sam: mitigation plan: 1) emit `x-proxy-quiesce: 1` header when proxy quiesces; 2) runtime to inject SSE markers `event: quiesce_start` and `event: quiesce_end` around pause; 3) add `stream.quiesce_duration_seconds` and `stream.silent_output_count` with labels (route, tenant, model) in console; 4) ops to relax quiesce aggressiveness in eu for now.

ryan: client SDK change: if `quiesce_start` seen, show non-blocking spinner and expect `quiesce_end`; if no marker and no frames >8s, client can attempt resume heuristics.

ops-bot: OPS ACTION: roll quiesce_threshold -> 0.4 in eu1 now; trace sampling -> 12% for 1h.

anya: created RB-4488, owners: anya(investigate), sam(telemetry/flags), ryan(runtime), tina(prod). target: hotfix today, full fix next minor. will post traces to ticket.

eng-bot: Note: avoid replaying tokens on resume; prefer explicit resume marker + idempotency hint.

sam: adding dashboard tile to correlate `proxy.quiesce_count` with `streaming.silent-output`. will update RB-4488.

anya: thanks, will follow up with short postmortem and customer notes. :thumbsup:
